title: The mana and stamina spend bars (show on spend, hold 1 s, fade by 2 s)
oneLine: Local MP/stamina block bars: appear on a spend, hold 1 s, fade by 2 s, swept on death.

title: Your own HP band over your head (event-shown, heal-held, hard swap with your name plate)
oneLine: Self HP bar revealed by HP change, held 2.5 s or while healing, plate hidden while it shows.
topConcern: HEAL_STALL_MS 9000 must outlast the worker's 6 s regen gap with nothing pinning them; fade steps per frame, slow on slow phones.

title: A monster's death on screen (stamp, cut or splat, strip fallback, display kept until DONE)
oneLine: Per-life death stamp on the monster, DEATH_NONE/LIVE/DONE decides display survival; reset by two respawn writers.
topConcern: Displays destroyed mid-death skip clearMonsterDeath; zone-death state lingers in _live until the next roll prunes it.

title: A monster's arrival flourish (white silhouette that grows in over 620 ms)
oneLine: Alive-edge detector stamps _spawnFxAt; white filter, alpha and scale grow in, removed only on the alive path.
topConcern: A monster killed in its first ~410 ms keeps the white filter, low alpha and shrunken scale through its whole death.

title: The blue slime's death swell (and the giant slime's split swell): intangible while _burstUntil is set
oneLine: Client copy of a slime's swell; ends only on the execute event; makes the slime intangible and swollen.
topConcern: A rejoin after the slime exploded and respawned carries the swell onto the new life: drawn swollen, unhittable, untargetable on that phone.

title: The snowman's burrow on screen (dig, pile, emerge; self-clearing mirror of the worker's phase)
oneLine: Event, tick and renderer self-clear keep a snowman's burrow phase and its client invulnerability flag.
topConcern: A phone meeting the pile only via the tick arms 400 ms; renderer clears at 900 ms, tick re-arms: blinking mound and intangibility gaps.

title: A monster's wind-up throb (scale pulse that tightens until the strike)
oneLine: Wind-up until-stamp from the wire drives a scale throb; renderer self-clears and stamps _tgSeen.

title: A monster's body strip: which animation plays and which way it faces
oneLine: Three hand-written animation priority ladders (variant, slime, snowman) over hit/attack/transform stamps; two-sighting facing hysteresis.
topConcern: Each new strip adds a rung by hand in three ladders that already disagree on interrupt order; opaque, no live bug found.

title: A monster's head band: HP bar in a fight, name plate at rest
oneLine: One predicate (locked with intent or hit by you within 3 s) swaps a monster's plate for its HP bar.

title: A monster's head marks: the notice !, the stun ring and countdown, the status dots
oneLine: Time-gated notice, stun and status marks on one Graphics with a clear-once dirty latch.
topConcern: Stun stars compare the worker's epoch with the phone clock; cosmetic skew.

title: The Wheel's no-look-not-drawn gate (renderer half of the walk-in look loader)
oneLine: Renderer destroys a Wheel monster's display while its look is not ready; loader frees unneeded looks.

title: Who gets drawn: far cull and crowd cap for monsters, players and their pets
oneLine: Per-frame far cull and crowd cap hide displays; per-peer timers only advance while a peer is drawn.
topConcern: Corpse self-heal and ask-icon expiry freeze while a peer is culled and resume with the new position as death spot.

title: Another player's corpse (death sprite until player_respawned, or until the corpse walks away)
oneLine: Peer _isDead set and cleared by one-shot events; renderer also clears it after 1.5 s and 24 px of movement.
topConcern: A peer culled while dead and missed respawn event is drawn as a corpse at the new place until they walk 24 px.

title: Another player's raised shield (block pose, held shield) from the sticky player_shield relay
oneLine: Peer guard is a sticky boolean set only by the player_shield relay; drives block pose, held shield, hidden weapon.
topConcern: Down edge dropped when the peer is in another zone, lost on rejoin, never repeated by tick: observers show a guard up forever or never.

title: Another player's body pose and stride
oneLine: Peer copy of the self pose ladder from relayed and ticked fields, with moving hysteresis and stride phase.
topConcern: Hand copy of the self ladder: peers lack pickup and smithing poses, so a peer smithing stands still; timed poses end in three files.

title: Another player's HP bar in a fight (8 s after a reported hit, swaps with their plate, band lifted off yours)
oneLine: Peer HP bar shown 8 s after each pvp_hit, plate as complement, band eased clear of yours.

title: Marks over another player: the PvP threat skull and the no-man's-land duel-ask icon
oneLine: Time-gated threat skull with cached phase; duel-ask icon created on demand, destroyed on expiry.
topConcern: S._threatMarks may be a plain {} keyed by peer ids (house rule says null-prototype); ids are worker-issued.

title: Your own corpse (held 3.5 s or while HP is 0; the renderer seeds the stamp)
oneLine: Self corpse = hp<=0 or within 3.5 s of _deathStart; seven writers in five files; renderer seeds the stamp.
topConcern: Corpse path returns early, freezing every stand-in flag _updatePlayer publishes; each reader must re-ask selfCorpseUp.

title: Your own pose, facing and the stand-in hand-off
oneLine: Nine-rung pose and eleven-rung facing ladders; publishes stand-in flags for effectsRenderer and the facing BroTown broadcasts.
topConcern: Published flags refresh only inside their own branch and freeze on the corpse; readers hold by convention; renderer's facing goes on the wire.

title: The weapon in your hand (fist hole mask, eased hand position, hand cap and arm clones)
oneLine: Inverse stencil fist-hole mask with an on/off latch and eased hand position keyed by facing, pose, type.

title: The stat scene's photo shoot (capturePoseFrames)
oneLine: Swaps in a private player display and runs _updatePlayer on a fake state to photograph roll and jog frames.
topConcern: Fake state keeps real _jump/_climb/_ride/_farmWork; module state (_lastWeaponSprite, bake epoch, head watch) not restored.

title: Your pet and other players' pets on screen
oneLine: Local pet display (follow, fetch run, ward ring) and peer pets eased behind owners, gated on petshow cap.

title: Scenery props and foreground pieces (texture bound on first sight, dropped on zone change)
oneLine: Per-prop sprite texture binding EMPTY to bound to EMPTY, dropping textures the zone change frees.

title: A townsperson's figure: live from their look near you, a photograph otherwise, nothing when far
oneLine: Townsperson display built live near, destroyed far, photo fallback re-binds destroyed textures, marks lifted once.

title: A townsperson's quest mark (offer tag, waiting ?, ready check; else the talk bubble)
oneLine: Quest giver mark computed per frame on the phone from the quest model; renderer caches badge per marker string.
topConcern: Ready check is the phone's own predicate over its own bag; can disagree with what the worker accepts at hand-in.

title: The harvest stand-in hand-off (body put away while the gathering figure draws)
oneLine: Self or peer body hidden only once the chop/cook/fire/farm stand-in exists; corpse paths re-show it.

title: The staff's crystal position handed to the cast effects (trusted for 250 ms)
oneLine: Renderer stamps staff tip position and behind-ness each drawn frame; cast effects ignore tips older than 250 ms.

title: The resonance streak badge over your head
oneLine: Badge shows the client-computed resonance streak count for 10 s after the last resonant combo.
topConcern: Badge hard-codes 10000 instead of RESONANCE_STREAK_WINDOW_MS; the streak and its mana bonus are computed on the phone.
